rules.name: cs-31-verify-pr342-343-deployment
rules.sql: SELECT 'fn_statement_position_summaries_v2 is not v9 (no bookingContractMonth): the Liquibase changeset fn_statement_position_summaries_v2-v9 did not run' AS problem WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_proc WHERE pronamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND proname = 'fn_statement_position_summaries_v2' AND position('bookingContractMonth' in prosrc) > 0)

SELECT count(*) AS rows_in_cache, min(value_date) AS min_value_date, max(value_date) AS max_value_date FROM opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table WHERE tenant_id = :tenant AND business_unit = 'CFS'

SELECT b.contract_number, b.contract_month AS booking_contract_month, c.product_code, c.contract_month AS cache_contract_month, c.active_lots FROM opera.client_statement_booking_order_information_table b LEFT JOIN opera.helper_client_statement_report_view_cache_table c ON c.contract_number = b.contract_number AND c.tenant_id = b.tenant_id AND c.business_unit = b.business_unit WHERE b.contract_number IN ('SMH_OU_056', 'SMH_OU_057', 'SMH_OU_060') AND b.business_unit = 'CFS' AND b.tenant_id = :tenant ORDER BY b.contract_number

SELECT t.client_code, t.currency AS threshold_currency FROM opera.client_threshold_master t WHERE t.business_unit = 'CFS' AND t.tenant_id = :tenant AND NOT (upper(btrim(coalesce(t.currency, ''))) ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$') ORDER BY t.client_code

expect.reason: Position summaries function must be v9
